description: Form 4562 — depreciation for an individual's businesses and rentals, tax years 2025-2027 (calendar year): § 179 expensing with the dollar limit, phase-out, married-filing-separately split, business income limitation and carryover; the § 168(k) special allowance (100% for property acquired after January 19, 2025; 40% in 2025 and 20% in 2026 for property acquired earlier; the TY2025 40% election; election out by class); MACRS with the printed Publication 946 tables (half-year, mid-quarter by the 40% test, mid-month for buildings; 150% DB, straight-line and ADS elections); dispositions during the year; listed property and the § 280F passenger automobile limits (2025 and 2026); and Rev. Proc. 87-56 asset classes for cost segregation (assetClass, e.g. '57.0', '00.11', '00.3'). Give EVERY asset in service: current-year assets with cost, placedInService and acquiredOn (the binding-contract date, which sets the bonus percentage); earlier assets also with convention (HY/MQ), section179Taken and specialAllowanceTaken. section179BusinessIncome is required when § 179 is elected or carried over (taxable income from actively conducted businesses including wages, without § 179, the half-SE-tax deduction or any NOL). Returns the form's lines, each asset's schedule, and the deduction by activity (Schedule C line 13, Schedule E line 18) — subtract each activity's amount from that business's income before depreciation. Situations the sources don't settle (short years, general asset accounts, 100% bonus on a passenger car, § 280F recapture, a disposition in the last recovery year) refuse with the reason. Report the lines and notes verbatim; dollars in, whole dollars out.

acquiredOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the binding written contract date — required for the special allowance

activity.description: which business or rental it belongs to; totals are reported per activity

assetClass.description: Rev. Proc. 87-56 class (Pub 946 Table B-1/B-2) instead of recoveryClass

convention.description: earlier-year assets: the convention used when placed in service

cost.description: cost or other basis, excluding land

section1245Property.description: 15/20-year property and asset class 57.1: is it § 1245 property (asked only when § 179 is used)

section179.description: § 179 expense elected for this asset (current year)

specialAllowanceTaken.description: earlier-year assets: special allowance taken (0 if none)

spouseSection179Cost.description: MFS: cost of § 179 property your spouse placed in service
